svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.26.2.4 Staples
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.26 ROOFING

g.text: An 11 mm (7/16″) crown may be used as provided
Asphalt shingles: 19 mm long, 1.6 mm wire,
25 mm crown, all not less than, (2)
Wood shingles: 29 mm long, 1.6 mm wire,
9.5 mm crown, all not less than, (3)

svg.text: Staples used to apply asphalt or wood shingles
are corrosion-resistant and are driven with
the crown parallel to the eaves.
Staples used with asphalt shingles are not
diam or thickness, with not less than a 25 mm
(1″) crown, except that an 11 mm (7/16″) crown
may be used as provided in Sentence
Staples used with wood shingles are not less
than 29 mm (1⅛″) long, 1.6 mm (0.063″) diam or
thickness, with not less than a 9.5 mm (⅜″)
crown and are stainless steel or aluminum.
Drawn: A and B to scale at the minimum sizes. C shows staples on the top course before the next course covers them. Staple positions are illustration only.
